'''Dorian''' (Japanese:  '''リュウジ''' ''Ryūji'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|GS}} episode ''[[EP256|Just Add Water]]''.

Dorian is a {{type|Water}} [[Pokémon Trainer]] who runs the unofficial {{DL|Gym|Coastline Gym}} on the eastern shores of the [[Johto]] [[region]]. Dorian puts on synchronized swimming shows with his Pokémon because he is a big fan of the [[Sensational Sisters]]: {{an|Daisy}}, {{an|Violet}}, and {{ka|Lily}}. He regularly visits the [[Cerulean Gym]] for inspiration and hopes to someday open the Coastline Gym to League challengers. Dorian's Gym {{pkmn|battle}}s take place underwater, with Trainers using scuba diving gear to remain with their Pokémon. This makes the battles dynamic, with opponents able to deal blows from a multitude of angles.

In ''[[EP256|Just Add Water]]'', {{an|Misty}} was enraged when Dorian claimed Lily was prettier than she was and subsequently challenged him to a battle. {{Ash}} decided to challenge Dorian first, though his {{AP|Totodile}} was defeated by Dorian's {{p|Lanturn}}. Misty went up against Dorian in a three-on-three battle; Dorian and Misty won a round each. However, the third round was interrupted by {{TRT}}, who used their [[Team Rocket's mechas|underwater mecha]] to kidnap several of the Water Pokémon, along with Dorian and Misty.

Ash and Brock soon located the trio with [[Ash's Noctowl]], while [[Misty's Psyduck]], powered by its swelling headache prompted by {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}}'s {{m|Bite}}, unleashed a powerful {{m|Psychic}} to blast Team Rocket off. Dorian and the others were reunited with their Pokémon shortly after. Misty was still keen to continue the match, though Dorian admitted Psyduck's surprising strength would easily defeat him. The pair agreed to a draw, and Dorian came to understand that Misty was just as strong as her sisters. Before the group left, Dorian took a commemorative photo with Misty, her {{TP|Misty|Corsola}}, and Psyduck, which he pinned alongside his collection of Sensational Sisters photos.
